description:
This team is an initiative of Physics Engineering Students from Instituto Superior Técnico, Lisbon.

 We are hardworking and inventive students with a deep motivation to design engineering solutions, come up with out-of-the-box ideas for the benefit of people, and look for new approaches to implement and test our technical knowledge.

Looking for members!

Rafael Morais

Vasco Meneses Tomás
summary: We developed an app that integrates data about the azimuth of the relative positions of Earth, Sun and Moon to calculate the conditions at a given site in the Moon's south pole: lightness, Sky view, timeline of the Earth and Sun positions, etc. It is programmed primarily in Python and uses an intuitive user interface.
details: The presentation provides information about how to use the app.
dataRefs: NASA’s Planetary Geology, Geophysics and Geochemistry Laboratory - A new view of the lunar south pole from LOLA
